reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "⚠️ Images: Remove OpenTelemetry", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The init container and image that installed OpenTelemetry at controller startup are no longer deployed or published; OpenTelemetry keeps working through the module built into the controller image since v1.10.
consequence.remediation: Remove any references to the separate OpenTelemetry init image and rely on the module built into the controller image.

proposed.statement: ingress-nginx 1.12.0 removes the OpenTelemetry init container and its image, which used to install the module when the controller started; OpenTelemetry is still supported because the module has been built into the controller image since v1.10.
